description: This source file defines a feature class for listing comments associated with an article identified by a slug within an ASP.NET Core application. It includes a query object, a query handler that interacts with Entity Framework to retrieve article comments, and handles not found errors.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the query and handler related to listing comments for an article based on its slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments of an article, returning a CommentsEnvelope or throwing an exception if not found.
